name: OSB Group Plc
research_rationale: Nine-month trading update confirms resilient performance vs 2026 guidance, partly supporting cheapness/yield, but statutory EPS decline and unchanged lowered NIM/RoTE outlook still weaken the strong-buy case.

weekly_updates.summary:
Strong-buy screen unchanged (four weeks, stable; cheapness, dividend and risk families still pass).
Since 20 Oct, disclosures are routine only: total voting rights (30 Oct), director/PDMR shareholding (27 Oct), ongoing buybacks; no trading update or results.
News hits on unrelated North American lumber/OSB names; nothing new on OSB Group’s H1 NIM/RoTE or statutory EPS story.

Strong-buy screen unchanged (five weeks, stable); cheapness, dividend and risk families still pass; quoted yield ~7.5%.
Since 30 Oct, no new RNS in the news batch and no trading update or results—last disclosure was total voting rights (30 Oct).
Fundamental picture unchanged: H1 NIM/RoTE guidance cuts and statutory EPS decline still anchor the thesis; routine buybacks only.

Strong-buy screen stable at seven weeks; cheapness, dividend and risk families still pass (~7.1% yield).
5 Nov RNS: nine-month trading update in line with 2026 guidance (loan book +1.9%, CET1 15.4%, arrears 1.6%); £100m buyback complete; holdco tender offer and Chair designate announced.
2026 guidance unchanged from interim, so H1 NIM/RoTE guide-down and statutory EPS decline remain the main offsets.
